content.text:
I found the red ball. The robot is now about 25–30 cm from it, facing it, and resting with its motors off. The last camera image after crouching shows the ball centered just in front of its feet.

1. I couldn't see the ball from the starting spot, so I walked about 1.5 m forward, then about 1.2 m to the left into the open area.
2. From there I spotted the ball about 90° to the left, near a whiteboard stand. I walked about 1.8 m toward it.
3. When I looked again, it wasn't in front of me. The robot had walked past it, and a sharp left look found it right beside its left shoulder.
4. I turned to face it, took one small step and made two small turns to center it.

The robot never fell or bumped into anything. Battery is at 43% and charging.
